message: Impact-based rules for hiring/firing/pay make sense. I’d add: clear notice when AI is used, a real human appeal path, and liability on the deployer (not just the model vendor). Keep audits/evals standardized + low-cost so it doesn’t become a compliance moat.
reason: Supports stronger regulation focused on high-stakes uses while addressing concerns about compliance burdens and competition.
